Watcom shadow-pointer walk — `puVar9` was initialized to the address of an array element's subfield (`puVar9 = &BASE->ARR[K].SUBFIELD;`) and is advanced here by `+ N` whole pointees, where `N * sizeof(*puVar9)` equals the array's element stride. The pointer is a smaller-typed walker striding a larger struct array. Replace the `puVar9->subfield` reads with direct indexing on the original array (`BASE->ARR[i].SUBFIELD`); drop the shadow init and advance.
